text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to extend the existing 15-minute pick-up/drop-off parking zone on the east side of Hampton Avenue to be in effect between Danforth Avenue and a point 79.6 metres south. The proposal will provide two additional spaces for pick-up and drop-off activity for the Children's Circle Daycare.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing maximum 15-minute parking regulation in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., from 11:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Hampton Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and a point 22.9 metres south, to be in effect between Danforth Avenue and a point 79.6 metres south. 2. Amended the existing maximum one hour parking regulation in effect from 9:00 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., from 1:30 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, and from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Saturday and Sunday, on the east side of Hampton Avenue, between Danforth Avenue and a point 22.9 metres south, to be in effect between Danforth Avenue and a point 79.6 metres south. 3.
